# Decision: one English version for all EU markets

**Decided 2026-02-12.** The English shop serves every EU country from one `en` locale with prices in euro. Country-specific English versions (en-DE, en-NL) would be near-duplicates and split the already small English authority. Shipping information is shown dynamically by IP, not through separate URLs.
